in_latin.meaning: festival of freedom, celebration of liberation, joyful occasion, happy time, time of rejoicing
in_latin.long_meaning: festivalus libertatis, celebratio liberationis, gaudium occasionis, felicitas temporis, tempus laetitiae. Ex vocabulis Hebraicis Ιαππό σερ (Σλοππώμεάλι ς πεπώλια ππώλις) et Γεγλάτη (σελεια γόλεία).

biblical_reference.note: The concept of Jubilee is introduced in Leviticus 25:8-55, where God commands the Israelites to observe a year of jubilee every 50 years, when all debts are forgiven, slaves are freed, and land is returned to its original owners.
